description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to selecting codecs and copiers for serialization purposes within the Orleans framework. It includes interfaces for codec and copier selectors, as well as delegate-based implementations for flexible type support determination.

classes.name: DelegateCodecSelector
classes.description: A sealed class implementing ICodecSelector that uses a delegate to determine if a type is supported.

classes.name: DelegateCopierSelector
classes.description: A sealed class implementing ICopierSelector that uses a delegate to determine if a type is supported.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Determines if the provided type is supported by invoking the delegate.
